example.a:
Stormy Night
by Sophia

The tree branches sway
With fear of what is to come—
A storm is brewing.

instruction.text: Do these clues help you know that this poem is a haiku? Choose true or false.

atoms.a: The fact that it is three lines long.
The fact that it is about a storm.
The amount of syllables in each line match the 5-7-5 rule.
The lack of rhymes is typical for haikus.

end.text: The structure of the poem points towards it being a haiku. Haikus do not typically rhyme and while traditionally they are inspired by nature, they can talk about different topics as well.
